title: decode.rs: ParseError::NoHeaders reused for body-range OOB
description: decode_body_value (line 27-29) returns Err(ParseError::NoHeaders) when body_range is out of bounds for the raw buffer. NoHeaders means the input had no RFC 5322 headers; it is the wrong variant for a range-bounds error on an already-parsed part. A reader hitting this error at runtime will look for a missing-headers condition that does not exist. Suggested rewrite: add ParseError::InvalidRange (or ParseError::InvalidPart) and return that here. The current reuse leaks how the author thought about the error, not what the error means.
close_reason: covered by MIME-72l.20 (same wrong error variant, higher priority)
